allot.subject: Dividend
allot.text: The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, viz. May 13, 2025, has considered and approved final dividend subject to the approval of the members @ 3,250 % i.e. Rs. 65/- per equity share (face value of Rs. 2/- per share). allot.subject: Record Date
allot.text: The Board of Directors at its meeting held today, viz. February 6, 2025, has considered and approved interim dividend @5000% i.e. Rs. 100/- per equity share for the financial year 2024-25.
